description: Land Acquisition - Palaly West, Myliddy North, Valikamam North D/S Division, Jaffna District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific lands being acquired by the government for the expansion of Palaly Airport, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, original claimants, and exact measurements. This fits perfectly within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisitions and property matters for public purposes.
